headline: Activists storm Microsoft datacentre site in Europe-wide protests
summary: More than 100 campaign groups across 15 countries organized "Stop Dirty Data Centres" protests, and activists including the Dutch group Geef Tegengas stormed the construction site of a Microsoft datacentre in Amsterdam, with organizers saying further actions are planned across Europe following a similar backlash in the US elections.

claims.statement: More than 100 campaign groups across 15 countries planned two days of "Stop Dirty Data Centres" protests in Europe.
